meta.source: Each program's own web page, opened on the check date (ENERGY STAR Rebate Finder used as the index of programs)
meta.notes: Water heater rebates from utilities and state programs in the 10 states with a state cost page (audit S-6, F-16). One record per program; quote = the exact words on the program page on the checked date. fuel: heat_pump = heat pump water heater, gas = gas tank or tankless. maxUsd = the largest amount the page names for a water heater (null when the page offers a discount without naming the amount). Pages that refused our checker (403, scripted pages) are listed under notChecked and are never shown as programs. Utility programs change often: review every three months with data/state-pages.json and data/incentives.json.

programs.offer: $1,000 replacing an electric water heater; up to $4,000 replacing a gas one
programs.conditions: SMUD electric customers. The rebate is higher for a gas-to-electric switch.
programs.quote: Up to $4,000 for gas-to-electric heat pump water heater conversions. ... $1,000 for electric-to-electric heat pump water heater and heat pump HVAC upgrades.

programs.sponsor: LADWP (Los Angeles Department of Water and Power)
programs.offer: Up to $2,500 per unit, based on gallon capacity and UEF
programs.conditions: LADWP residential electric customers; apply after purchase and installation, within 12 months of purchase.
programs.quote: Heat Pump Water Heaters are eligible for up to $2,500* per unit ... *Rebate amount is based on gallon capacity/UEF

programs.offer: $1,000 for an ENERGY STAR certified heat pump water heater
programs.conditions: Home served by Austin Energy; a heat pump water heater being replaced must be at least 10 years old.
programs.quote: Austin Energy offers a $1,000 rebate when you install a qualifying ENERGY STAR® certified hybrid/heat pump water heater

programs.offer: $350 for an ENERGY STAR certified heat pump water heater
Tankless: $700 replacing electric, $550 replacing gas. ENERGY STAR tank: $650 or $400. Standard tank: $550 or $350
programs.conditions: Peoples Gas customers; tankless units must deliver at least 5 GPM; apply within one year of installation.
programs.quote: Tank Water Heating $550 $350 ENERGY STAR Tank Water Heating $650 $400 Tankless Water Heating $700 $550

programs.offer: $1,500 instant rebate on a qualified ENERGY STAR heat pump water heater up to 120 gallons
programs.conditions: Bought at a participating Lowe's or Home Depot, or by your contractor from a participating distributor.
programs.quote: Get a $1,500 instant rebate for a qualified ENERGY STAR–certified* heat pump water heater with up to 120 gallons of storage capacity.

programs.offer: Up to $1,200 for an ENERGY STAR certified heat pump water heater
programs.quote: Apply Now for Rebates Up To $1,200 PSEG Long Island offers rebates for eligible ENERGY STAR ® certified heat pump water heaters

programs.offer: $400 for an ENERGY STAR certified heat pump water heater
programs.conditions: PPL residential customers. The page notes the program was updated after May 31, 2026; check the current terms before you buy.

programs.conditions: Columbia Gas of Pennsylvania residential customers.
programs.quote: $400 rebate for an Energy Star certified natural gas tankless water heater with an UEF of ≥.90

programs.quote: Tankless water heater - $150 Tanked/storage water heater - $150

programs.conditions: Georgia Power customers; installed by a program-affiliated installer.

programs.sponsor: Energy Saver North Carolina (NC DEQ, federal HEAR)

programs.conditions: Household income below 150% of area median; a program-registered contractor installs it.
